judged_text: The 'is able to remove a member' test never asserts the negative/edge paths of the rewritten remove_member action (non-member user_id, removing the last owner semantics, or that group.save's failure branch renders 422). The controller code `group.users.delete(user_id)` followed by an unconditional group.save is new logic whose only covered path is the happy path; a regression such as delete raising on an unknown id (ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound on some association setups) or the save-error branch rendering errors would ship unnoticed.

adjudication.rationale: Diff adds new controller path `Admin::GroupsController#remove_member` using `group.users.delete(user_id)` then `if group.save ... else render_json_error(group)` (new failure branch). The new spec in `context ".remove_member"` only covers (1) automatic group returns 422 and (2) successful removal when the user is a current member; it does not exercise the save-failure/error-rendering branch or behavior when `user_id` is not a member. That’s a concrete, diff-grounded test coverage gap for newly introduced logic, not a proven functional defect.
